description: The Raw Index — the site as an honest document. Black ink on white paper, classic link blue, 2–3px rules, zero radius, instant inverted hover states. A terminal status bar with a live UTC clock, a left-aligned monospace masthead, a README manifest, a hard-shadowed featured record, and the whole blog as one dense INDEX OF / table. Signature: a generative ASCII dither field seeded by the date.
